thread:
olivia: FYI NexusParts just updated lead times 12 weeks for the new H100 order. They can do a split: expedited air for a subset or sea for the remainder. Also flagged a "thermal variance" on one pallet that may trigger depot inspection.
sam: 12 weeks is brutal. How many GPUs do we need in the short term to prevent SLO/regression in Dedicated?
jordan: EU-west pool lost 24 GPUs overnight. We need at least 10 new/newish cards in-region to avoid autoscale backoff and single-instance pipelines.
maria: Cost check: vendor quoted +$1.8k/unit for air expedite. If we air-ship 10 units that's +$18k. Finance: is that approvable for SLA protection?
finance (maria): We can approve one-off up to $25k if infra signs off. Prefer vendor credit instead of immediate air surcharge.
toby: Operational asks for vendor: 1) split AWB so FRA depot gets EU units directly; 2) include HS code and invoice classification now to pre-clear customs.
olivia: Asked vendor for provisional AWBs and HS code. Vendor returned AWBs but still lists HSN 8542.31 (wrong). Also offered 6 A-grade refurb units immediately if we accept.
sam: Refurb A could be acceptable if warranty >=90 days and burn-in logs provided. We need KV cache health test results post-install.
jordan: Can we cross-dock at FRA to dodge the depot backlog? That reduced time by 48h last quarter. Also insist on exact serial manifest format  we've had mismatches before.
olivia: Sent vendor our manifest template `manifest_v2.csv` (columns: serial,model,fw_version,sku,received_ts) and asked for photos of pallets. Vendor acknowledged.
shipbot: NexusParts shipment created: AWB-EU: NXEU123456789, AWB-US: NXUS987654321. Air ETA to FRA (est): 2026-04-05 09:00 CET. US air ETA JFK est 2026-04-07. Sea manifest ETA 2026-04-28.
maria: Vendor offered $20k invoice credit if we accept 30 units by sea and they provide photos + depot inspection report on arrival. Credit is contingent.
toby: Please push vendor to accept responsibility for any customs reclassification fines. They are using the wrong HSN in paperwork; if customs reclass, we could be liable for duties + fines.
vendor-legal: Added to thread. NexusParts legal requests written amendment indemnifying Redwood for misclassification fines if caused by vendor paperwork error. They said yes but need signatures.
oleg: (olivia) vendor also offering to air-ship 8 new + 2 refurb A-grade to FRA for immediate burn-in if we authorize. Suggest we demand 2 units be labeled FRA-BURNIN-PRIORITY.
jordan: Approve 2 FRA-priority new units for burn-in. Infra needs 8 total in EU ASAP to stabilize. If vendor can guarantee those 2 in 48h for burn-in, approve air for them.
sam: Technical note: require burn-in harness run (kv-cache test v1.3) with logs attached. If latency >1ms for any step, vendor must replace within 72h.
toby: Also require insured value flagged on AWB and cross-dock tag: `FRA-CROSSDOCK-PRIORITY`. No partial shipment insurance.
olivia: Negotiated terms: vendor will air-ship 10 to EU (8 new + 2 refurb A) and 10 to US (all new). Remaining 30 by sea. Vendor agrees to $20k conditional credit, deliver manifest_v2.csv, photos within 24h of arrival, and depot inspection. Vendor will sign indemnity for HSN errors.
maria: Finance to draft credit memo template now. We'll mark credit as contingent until docs received.
jordan: Ops: I'll create the FRA burn-in ticket and reserve bench slots for 48h unpack + 48h burn-in. Tag `impact: dedicated` and `priority: high`.
toby: I'll prep kv-cache harness and smoke tests. Plan to run full suite during burn-in and capture traces.
shipbot: AWB-EU NXEU123456789 status: in-air, est arrive FRA 2026-04-05 09:00 CET. AWB-US NXUS987654321 status: in-transit est arrive JFK 2026-04-07. Sea manifest expected 2026-04-28.
olivia: Final decision: authorize air for 20 (10 EU incl 2 FRA-priority, 10 US); accept sea for remainder with $20k credit conditional on manifest + photos + signed indemnity. Approving now for vendor to book.
sam: Infra approves. We'll monitor SLOs and open rollback if regressions appear.
maria: Finance tracked the contingency and will post-credit once docs verified within 48h of arrival.
jordan: I'll update the rollout plan and postmortem template in case we need to record vendor SLA misses.
vendor-legal: Amendment drafted, sending secure link for signature. Will confirm once signed.
olivia: Thanks all. @vendor-legal and @nexusparts: please expedite signature and docs. :thumbsup:
